message.content: Set in post-Napoleonic Marseilles in 1815, this passage introduces Edmond Dantès, a young, skilled, and beloved sailor returning home on the ship *Pharaon* after the death of his captain, only to find himself at the center of a growing conspiracy orchestrated by the envious supercargo Danglars and fueled by the jealous Catalan Fernand, both of whom resent his imminent rise to captaincy and betrothal to the beautiful Mercédès.
